{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop QA orders
df = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Only keep completed orders
df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check that only 'email' and 'paid_search' are in channel
print(f'Unique channels: {df["channel"].unique()}')

# Check that only 'new', 'returning', 'loyal' are in customer_segment
print(f'Unique segments: {df["customer_segment"].unique()}')

# Confirm the dataframe has 809 rows
print(f'Dataframe shape: {df.shape}')"}
